rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you for this — genuinely glad you came up to talk at the meetup, and glad to hear you want to put real hours toward it. I'm still sorting out some logistics on my end (mainly a work-disclosure conversation I need to have before anything with my name on it goes fully public), so I'm not ready to make this a formal \"project\" yet. But there's useful, low-stakes groundwork that would help a lot and doesn't depend on any of that: Could you help me map the landscape of what's neglected? Specifically: a short survey of which AI risk areas currently have essentially no one measuring or tracking them (vs. areas that are already well covered by labs, academics, or existing eval orgs). Rough categories + a one-line \"who, if anyone, covers this\" + your best guess at the biggest gap would be exactly what I need to decide where a small, independent effort could actually matter instead of duplicating work. No deadline pressure — a couple of weeks is totally fine. Thank you again, truly. Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman (meetup contact who offered to help): gave her a concrete, unpaid starter task — survey what AI-risk areas are genuinely neglected vs. already covered

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold — and apologies, this reached me after your Tuesday noon deadline, so I don't want to hold up your piece. Halcyon Threshold is very new and I'm still working through some practical constraints before I'm ready to speak on the record by name. If you're doing a follow-up piece down the line, I'd be happy to talk then once things are more settled. Best of luck with the article, Morgan"
rows.quote: I sent brief, no-commitment replies declining/deferring both (no quote given, no letter signed)
